description.narrative: The Project is expected to provide financing to key financial intermediaries in the ECA/ Türkiye region, particularly Türkiye in the face of economic, trade, and supply chain disruptions caused by COVID-19 and other macroeconomic challenges. Indirectly, this increased capacity will also improve the availability of credit to local importers and exporters along key value chains and in a wide variety of sectors as well as increase climate-related financing.

The project (Project) is a three-year, funded risk sharing facility whereby MUFG Bank, Ltd. (MUFG) and IFC would share the risk up to 50%-50% in a portfolio of up to US$350 million of senior loans that MUFG provides to banks in the Europe, Central Asia and Türkiye Region. MUFG also uses the funds provided by IFC to invest in new Sustainable Energy Finance (SEF) projects. This Project is a renewal of prior projects.
